'''Gee-Gee Bee Four''' was a [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]]. He was determined to help his master find the identity of the [[Lobot/Legends|mysterious figure]] operating on [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]].<ref name="Game" />
